When traveling, health and safety are paramount. I was traveling alone in Thailand when I suddenly fell ill and experienced severe pain. After visiting several hospitals, I finally decided to have my check-up and surgery at this one. I'm so glad and grateful that I chose this hospital; the service and medical care were top-notch. The translators and nurses were all very friendly and helpful. The doctor was handsome, and I was a little nervous before entering the operating room, but the subsequent professional procedures put me at ease. I opted for spinal anesthesia, but I fell asleep during the surgery and didn't wake up until four hours later. Nurses and translators frequently checked on me and offered words of comfort, which was very thoughtful. The pricing was transparent, and everything was clearly explained. I hope everyone has a healthy, safe, and enjoyable trip!

I recently visited Vimut Hospital for a weight loss consultation, and I was genuinely impressed with the overall experience.

From the beginning, the staff were welcoming, professional, and very attentive. The consultation felt thorough and personalized rather than rushed. The doctor took time to understand my lifestyle, health background, and goals before suggesting a suitable weight management plan.

I appreciated how the program focused not only on quick results but also on long-term health and sustainable habits. Everything was clearly explained, and I felt supported throughout the process.

The hospital environment was clean, modern, and comfortable, which made the whole visit stress-free.

Overall, I highly recommend Vimut Hospital for anyone looking for professional and well-structured weight loss guidance with caring medical support.
